## Summary

<!-- One paragraph describing what this PR does and why. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] refactor — non-behavioural code change
- [ ] perf — performance improvement
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] chore — tooling, dependencies, CI
- [ ] test — adds or fixes tests
- [ ] style — formatting / styling only

## Linked issues

Closes #

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` (unit) passes
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` (when relevant) passes
- [ ] Manual smoke test on the affected page(s)

## Quality checklist

- [ ] Accessibility considered (keyboard nav, focus order, ARIA labels, color contrast)
- [ ] Reduced-motion / prefers-reduced-motion respected for new animations
- [ ] No PII / secrets added; no `.env*` committed
- [ ] No new console errors or warnings
- [ ] Bundle size impact reviewed (build output looks reasonable)
- [ ] Docs / README / ADR updated when relevant
